If you are under 18, please do not create an account or play. Play within your limits A few simple habits keep gaming healthy: Set a budget before you play and treat it as entertainment, not a way to make money. Never play with money you cannot afford to lose. Set time limits and take regular breaks. Do not try to win back losses by playing more. Do not play when stressed, upset, or under the influence of alcohol. Warning signs It may be time to step back if you notice yourself: Spending more time or money than you intended. Chasing losses or borrowing money to play.
